lines: For billions of years, nature has run the longest search there is.
数十亿年来，自然一直在进行最漫长的一场搜索。
Make random variations. Test them. Keep what survives.
随机产生变化，接受检验，留下幸存者。
It needs no plan, only a clear test. But it is slow.
它不需要计划，只需要明确的检验。但它很慢。
Neural network architectures are the foundation of AI.
神经网络架构是 AI 的基石。
Each leap came from a new architecture, yet designing one is still slow work for human experts.
每一次飞跃都来自新的架构，但设计架构仍然依赖专家，缓慢而昂贵。
Our target is one of the hardest: spiking language models.
我们挑战的是最难的任务之一：脉冲语言模型。
Their core, the token mixer that carries information along the sequence, must work with on-off spikes.
它的核心是沿序列传递信息的 token mixer，必须在 0/1 脉冲的约束下工作。
So far it has been hand-adapted from ordinary networks, not designed for spikes, yet it promises far more energy-efficient language models.
至今它都是从普通网络手工移植的，并非为脉冲而生；而一旦做对，语言模型可以省下大量能耗。
Our earlier work, OpenArchEvo, was the first to make evolution over whole architecture programs feasible.
我们之前的工作 OpenArchEvo，首次让演化搜索完整的架构程序成为可行。
A language model writes whole network programs, and evolution keeps the best.
大模型写出完整的网络程序，由演化留下最好的。
It found new spiking networks that beat expert designs.
它找到了超越专家设计的新型脉冲网络。
But like nature, it proposes a lot and remembers little: many paths wander, and many candidates fail.
但和自然一样，它提出很多、记住很少：许多路径走散，许多候选失败。
Breeders found a faster way.
育种者找到了更快的办法。
When experience guides the variation, good designs arrive much sooner.
让经验引导变化，好的设计会来得快得多。
The race still decides who wins.
但谁更好，仍然由比赛决定。
So we asked: can a team of AI agents be the breeders?
于是我们问：一支 AI Agent 团队，能不能成为育种者？
Agents propose, evolution decides.
众智提出，演化择优。
OpenArchEvo, with a research team of agents on SciencePal.
OpenArchEvo，加上 SciencePal 上的一支 Agent 科研团队。
The OpenArchEvo engine stays in the middle.
OpenArchEvo 引擎留在中间。
Around it, agents take on three jobs.
在它周围，Agent 承担三项工作。
A research lead reads every result and sets the next directions.
研究负责人读取全部结果，决定下一步方向。
A better score catches designs that only look good early.
更好的评分识别出“只在早期看起来好”的设计。
And model panels improve the method itself: the playbook, the scoring rules, the hypotheses.
模型面板则改进方法本身：Skill 手册、评分规则和科学假设。
Every idea is kept only if the tests agree.
每个想法只有通过检验才会被保留。
All of this runs on SciencePal.
这一切都运行在 SciencePal 上。
Unlike a single coding assistant, it gives the team real GPU labs that agents start and maintain themselves,
不同于单个编程助手，它给团队提供真实的 GPU 实验室，由 Agent 自己启动和维护；
sessions where several models work side by side,
多个模型可以在会话中并肩工作；
and a hosted Skill that the platform itself helps improve.
Skill 托管在平台上，平台还会帮助改进它。
Does it work? We ran both from the same start, three times each.
效果如何？我们从同一起点，各运行三次。
With OpenArchEvo's original selection, six of twelve delivery tests were clearly worse than the expert.
用 OpenArchEvo 原来的选择方式：十二次交付检验中，有六次明显比专家差。
Add the agents' score and research lead: none.
加入 Agent 的新评分和研究负责人：一次都没有。
Like a breeder, the lead steers the search away from dead ends.
像育种者一样，研究负责人让搜索避开死胡同。
Here is one decision in action.
来看一个真实的决定。
The lead saw a gated design regress and suggested gating only the values.
负责人看到一个门控设计退步了，建议只门控 value 路径。
The proposer wrote exactly that, and it became the team's best delivery.
提案 Agent 照此写出程序，它成为团队最好的交付。
The search also finds things a person would not think to draw.
搜索还会找到人不会想到去画的结构。
A gate driven by spikes, zeros and ones, lowers perplexity from 71.8 to 68.95.
一个由 0/1 脉冲驱动的门，把困惑度从 71.8 降到 68.95。
Feed it ordinary numbers, or add the usual sigmoid, and the gain disappears.
换成普通的连续数值，或加上常见的 sigmoid，优势就消失了。
Even explanations are tested.
连解释也要接受检验。
Four of five models proposed the same fix. The GPU rejected it.
五个模型中有四个提出了同一个改进，GPU 实验否定了它。
Everything is open: the code, every architecture with its history, and every Skill version.
全部开源：代码、每个架构及其演化记录、Skill 的每个版本。
OpenArchEvo searches like nature: it works, but it remembers little.
OpenArchEvo 像自然一样搜索：有效，但记住的很少。
With agents as breeders, every result becomes experience: less waste, fewer failures.
有了像育种者一样的 Agent，每个结果都变成经验：浪费更少，失败更少。
Agents propose, evolution decides.
众智提出，演化择优。
